key.name: default-duration
key.description: Countdown length in seconds used on show and on reset. 600 = 10:00.

key.name: toggle-hotkey
key.description: Show/hide the island. Auto-starts on show.

key.name: x-offset
key.description: Pixels from top-center. Set by dragging the island.

key.name: y-offset
key.description: Pixels from the top edge of the primary monitor. 0 docks the tab flush to the edge.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Countdown label font size in px.

key.name: h-padding
key.description: Horizontal padding inside the pill, in px.

key.name: top-padding
key.description: Top padding above the countdown label, in px.

key.name: bottom-padding
key.description: Bottom padding below the countdown label, in px.

key.name: bottom-radius
key.description: Convex rounding of the two free bottom corners, in px.

key.name: top-fillet
key.description: Concave scoop radius where the tab meets the screen edge, in px. 0 = square butt joint.
